instruction: A candid studio photograph, medium close-up shot. In an indoor studio with a soft pink and purple gradient background, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) on the left poses with the man in the black vest and white t-shirt (R2) on the right. The blonde woman (R3) smiles, looking toward him with her left hand resting on his shoulder. The man (R2) faces forward, looking directly at the camera with a playful, intense expression while dancing. Warm, soft studio lighting illuminates the pair, casting gentle pink and lavender hues across the scene.
